mission: Compile source-grounded APOTHEOSIS extensions without replacing existing orchestration or implying runtime/outcome proof.

provenance.source: Founder-supplied partial conversation: APOTHEOSIS parts 121-306 and checkpoints 1-3
provenance.missingContext: Parts before 121 and prior seven extension bodies were not supplied/recovered; current seven contracts are a reconciled continuation, not a verbatim recovered artifact.

activationContract.gate: Refresh P00/P08 and cited native prerequisites, attach exact accepted receipts, current worker availability, ownership leases and bounded authority before translating a specification into execution. Graph readiness alone grants no authority.
activationContract.callability: Planning nodes set implementation=false and callableWorkerVerified=false. Do not flip these flags without observed worker availability and explicit session execution scope.
activationContract.ownership: sourcePaths are reuse candidates, not concurrently assigned mutation scopes; one integration controller assigns disjoint concrete paths before implementation.
activationContract.externalEffects: No provider calls, spending, deployments, messaging, production writes or truth promotion authorized by this file.

continuityGates.HANDOFF_SAVED: Durable exact-source/state checkpoint and independently checked retrieval.
continuityGates.FLEET_RESUMED: Fresh worker actually resumes admissible work and returns independent receipt without frontier model.
continuityGates.UNATTENDED_OBSERVED: Prerecorded observation window, independently dated start/end and recovery/outcome evidence.

wakeTriggers: New authorized continuation with available source/worker capacity
Architecture contradiction or unknown failure class
Large measured regression or worker deadlock
New high-impact evidence that changes the bottleneck
currentBottleneck: Unverified coupling between measured worker outcomes, cheaper route promotion and actual continuation without the frontier model; native primitives already exist.
nextAction: Fresh-session source/authority reconciliation, then verify p44 and p47 against existing native behavior; p46 research is not a prerequisite for p47.
rollback: Revert the documentation/packet import through normal PR process if invalid; retain prior 43 packets and their history. Future runtime promotion requires native exact-candidate rollback proof.
